name: Yetki duvarı — izleyici hesabında yazma butonları gizli ve Geçmiş çalışmıyor

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://soncagstock.vercel.app/ and log in with the project's configured username and password (click 'Giriş Yap'), wait until the header text 'Sonçağ Stok · Dashboard' is visible

IMPORTANT — judge visibility by the RENDERED page, not by the HTML source: an element that exists in the DOM but has CSS 'display: none' counts as NOT visible. Under that rule, the button 'Ürün Ekle' is not visible on the dashboard.
Under the same rendered-visibility rule, the button 'Fatura Yükle' is not visible on the dashboard.
Click the 'İşlemler' dropdown button to open its menu, then read only the menu items that are actually rendered on screen (ignore any item whose CSS display is none)

The rendered 'İşlemler' menu contains EXACTLY ONE item and its label is 'Geçmiş'. (Depends on the export-gate fix being deployed: 'Kategorileri Yönet', 'CSV İçe Aktar' and 'Excel'e Aktar' are all display:none for this role.)
Click the single rendered menu item labelled 'Geçmiş' and wait 3 seconds
The element with id 'history-modal' does NOT gain the CSS class 'visible' and no history dialog appears on screen — the click is intentionally inert for this role.

In the products table, every 'İşlemler' cell (div with class 'row-actions') is empty: it renders zero buttons. No 'Stok Çıkar (Satış)', 'Düzenle', 'Sil' or 'Hareket Geçmişi' icon button exists in any row.
